articles.title: Nachrichtenpodcast: Was, wenn die Straße von Hormus geschlossen bleibt?
articles.teaser: Wenig deutet darauf hin, dass die Straße von Hormus bald wieder offen ist. Was heißt das für die Weltwirtschaft? Und: Warum Wahlen in Deutschland so gut funktionieren.
articles.image_title: Nachrichtenpodcast: A crew member walks on the deck of an oil and chemical tanker, moored on the Garonne river at a petroleum depot in Ambes, near Bordeaux, south-western France, on May 5, 2026. The Strait of Hormuz has been largely blocked since February 28, 2026, when the United States and Israel launched coordinated airstrikes on Iran, with the waterway previously accounting for roughly 20% of the world's seaborne oil trade.
